name: Round Table
summary: A split-the-bill calculator around a round table, where coins fly from the bill to every plate
about: A bill splitter for dinner with friends in rupees. Enter the bill, slide the tip and add or remove people: chairs and plates spring into place round the table and coins fly from the bill to each plate as the shares roll to their new values. Tap a plate to give one person a fixed amount and the rest is split between the others, with rounding to PKR 10 or exact rupees, clear errors when the numbers cannot work and a summary you can copy.
how: Type the bill and drag the brass Tip slider (or use the arrow keys)
Use the minus and plus buttons to change how many people are at the table
Tap a plate to lock a fixed share for that person, or press Split equally to undo it
Turn Round to PKR 10 on or off, then press Send payment requests to tick every plate and see the summary
